text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian health care system lacks funds to serve 200 Hyundai emergency vans which were bought last year.

- Polish President Alexander Kwasniewski ratified a free trade agreement between Lithuania and Poland on Friday. The agreement is to come into force on January 1, 1997. Lithuania has already ratified the agreement, which considerably reduces customs duties on industry and agricultural products.

- Parliament's Budget and Finance Committee proposed increasing Lithuania's budget deficit by 400 million litas in 1996. Analysts say this could damage the country's credit rating. Lithuania was granted Ba2 rating by Moody's earlier this year and European IBCA agency rating is due to be published before Christmas.
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas, speaking at the Dublin summit on Saturday, said Lithuania supports the European Union's efforts in fighting organised crime.
